assign.card: live-not-polling: Sessions page and pollers use the JSONL tail

log.msg: Servex.js publish() appends {agent: card} to public/framework/ai/sessions/agents.jsonl on each card change; sessions/AgentsJSONL.js watch() tails it; Sessions tab and Dashboard sessions tile no longer poll /api/agents. Needs a Servex restart to start writing.

decision.question: Where does the pushed stream live?
options: own file under public/ written by Servex
make the dev tail serve Servex's log dir
decision.chose: own file under public/ written by Servex
decision.why: Servex Log writes outside public/, which the tail cannot serve; widening the tail is a security-surface change.
